title: Quantitative torsion reflection (kernel half)
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $I,K$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-closed-subscheme], $M$ a coherent $I$-adic system, $N$ a coherent $K$-adic system [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $H$ a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent]. For every $q\geq1$ and every Noetherian instance on $V(K^q)$, assume completion with respect to the extended ideal $I\mathcal O_{V(K^q)}$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal] is an equivalence. Supply $\alpha:M\to\widehat H_I$, $\delta:N\to\widehat H_K$, and natural isomorphisms $\theta_{e,n}:(H/K^{e+1}H)/I^{n+1}\cong(H/I^{n+1}H)/K^{e+1}$ and $\sigma_{e,n}:N_e/I^{n+1}N_e\cong M_n/K^{e+1}M_n$. Assume $\sigma_{e,n}$ followed by $\alpha_n$ modulo $K^{e+1}$ equals $\delta_e$ modulo $I^{n+1}$ followed by $\theta_{e,n}$ for every $e,n\geq0$. If $t\geq1$ and $K^t$ annihilates the ordinary sheaf kernels and cokernels of every $\alpha_n$, then $K^{4t}$ annihilates the ordinary sheaf kernels and cokernels of every $\delta_e$. The systems and morphisms are fixed inputs; this statement has no existence conclusion and imposes no quotient-projection condition on $\theta$. This node isolates the kernel conjunct.

source.place: Tags 088A, lemma-existence-tricky, the K^(2t) and K^(4t) bounds; 0888, remark-inverse-systems-kernel-cokernel-annihilated-by

proof.text: For each n, package the coherent source and target of alpha_n as coherent modules and apply coherentMap_reduction_torsion with reduction ideal K, annihilating ideal K and level e. This gives exponent 2t for both ordinary kernels and cokernels after reduction modulo K^(e+1).

Apply kernel.mapIso and cokernel.mapIso to the isomorphisms sigma_(e,n), theta_(e,n) and the supplied square. Naturality of ideal products transports the zero products from the reduced alpha_n to delta_e modulo I^(n+1). The proved private helper obtains this naturality from formalModuleQuotient_factor and cancels the isomorphism.

The K-adic conditions annihilate the coherent source and target of delta_e by K^(e+1). Apply coherentMap_completion_torsion_kernel_reflection on that fixed thickening with s=2t, using hthick at e+1. Rewrite 2*(2t)=4t.

theorem grothendieckDevissage_secondAdicSystem_torsion_kernel
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (M : CoherentFormalModule X I)
    (hthick : ∀ (e : ℕ), 1 ≤ e →
      ∀ (hZ : IsNoetherian (K ^ e).subscheme),
        Functor.IsEquivalence
          (@completion ((K ^ e).subscheme) hZ (I.comap (K ^ e).subschemeι)))
    (H : CoherentModules X) (α : M ⟶ (completion X I).obj H)
    (θ : formalCompletionSystem K H.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor I ≅
      (formalCompletionSystem I H.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor K).flip)
    (N : CoherentFormalModule X K) (δ : N ⟶ (completion X K).obj H)
    (σ : N.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor I ≅
      (M.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor K).flip)
    (hsquare : ∀ e n : ℕ,
        (σ.hom.app (op e)).app (op n) ≫
          formalModuleQuotientMap K (α.hom.app (op n)) (Nat.le_refl (e + 1)) =
        formalModuleQuotientMap I (δ.hom.app (op e)) (Nat.le_refl (n + 1)) ≫
          (θ.hom.app (op e)).app (op n))
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hα : ∀ n : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
        (kernel (α.hom.app (op n)))) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
        (cokernel (α.hom.app (op n))))) :
    ∀ e : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι (4 * t)).2
        (kernel (δ.hom.app (op e))))
